    19→// Layer Name Normalization
    20→
    21→/// Normalize a layer name by stripping `{page_id}/` prefix if present
    22→///
    23→/// **Context**: Lua apps and wire protocol use prefixed names (`{page_id}/messages`)
    24→/// but Scribe stores layers with bare names (`messages`). This strips the prefix
    25→/// at the Scribe boundary so all internal lookups use consistent bare names.
    26→pub fn normalize_layer_name(name: &str, page_id: &str) -> String {
    27→    let prefix = format!("{}/", page_id);
    28→    if let Some(bare) = name.strip_prefix(&prefix) {
    29→        bare.to_string()
    30→    } else {
    31→        name.to_string()
    32→    }
    33→}
    34→
    35→// Capture Helpers
    36→
    37→/// Shorten a DID to its last 12 characters for compact logging
    38→pub fn short_did(did: &str) -> &str {
    39→    let start = did.len().saturating_sub(12);
    40→    &did[start..]
    41→}
    42→
    43→/// Shorten a layer name by collapsing `did:key:...` segments to `...`
    44→pub fn layer_short(name: &str) -> String {
    45→    name.split('/')
    46→        .map(|seg| {
    47→            if seg.starts_with("did:key:") {
    48→                "..."
    49→            } else {
    50→                seg
    51→            }
    52→        })
    53→        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    54→        .join("/")
    55→}

    57→// Sync Configuration
    58→
    59→/// Sync mode derived from permit capabilities
    60→///
    61→/// **Design**: Capability-based, not role-based
    62→/// - Mode is derived from permit's sync configuration
    63→/// - No hardcoded role names in decision logic
    64→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    65→pub enum SyncMode {
    66→    /// Sync to a specific source node (users sync to their node)
    67→    ToSource,
    68→    /// Broadcast to all authorized peers (node mode)
    69→    Broadcast,
    70→}
    71→
    72→impl Default for SyncMode {
    73→    fn default() -> Self {
    74→        SyncMode::Broadcast
    75→    }
    76→}
    77→
    78→/// Sync configuration derived from permit
    79→///
    80→/// **Context**: Determines how this Scribe syncs based on permit capabilities
    81→/// - ToSource: Sync to a specific source node (owner/viewer/customer)
    82→/// - Broadcast: Broadcast to all authorized peers (node)
    83→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    84→pub struct SyncConfig {
    85→    /// Sync mode derived from permit (capability-based)
    86→    pub mode: SyncMode,
    87→    /// For ToSource: node_id to sync to
    88→    /// For Broadcast: None (uses list_authorized_users callback)
    89→    pub sync_target: Option<String>,
    90→}

    92→// Subscriber Types
    93→
    94→/// Information about a subscribed peer
    95→///
    96→/// **Design**: Stores the parsed permit directly instead of extracted fields.
    97→/// All access checks delegate to gurkha::Permit methods, ensuring consistency.
    98→pub struct SubscriberInfo {
    99→    /// Parsed page permit for all access checks (static layers)
   100→    /// Stores the full permit so we can use its methods directly
   101→    pub permit: gurkha::Permit,
   102→    /// Subscriber's DID (for pattern expansion with {aud})
   103→    /// Extracted from permit audience and normalized to DID format
   104→    pub subscriber_did: String,
   105→    /// Whether this subscriber is visible (from permit presence config)
   106→    /// Visible peers have their entry written to the presence layer
   107→    pub is_visible: bool,
   108→    /// Whether this subscriber can see others' presence
   109→    /// Gates whether the presence layer is synced to this peer
   110→    pub can_see_others: bool,
   111→    /// Display name for this subscriber (from permit presence config)
   112→    pub display_name: Option<String>,
   113→    /// Channel to send CRDT broadcasts
   114→    pub broadcast_tx: mpsc::Sender<BroadcastPayload>,
   115→    /// Channel to send ephemeral broadcasts (cursor, typing)
   116→    /// PeerActor creates this, spawns listener that sends datagrams
   117→    pub ephemeral_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<EphemeralOutbound>>,
   118→    /// Their last known state vectors (layer_name → version_vector)
   119→    pub vectors: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
   120→}
   121→
   122→impl SubscriberInfo {
   123→    /// Check if subscriber can receive updates for layer via page permit
   124→    pub fn can_receive_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str) -> bool {
   125→        // Block presence layer for peers who can't see others
   126→        if (layer_name == "presence" || layer_name.ends_with("/presence")) && !self.can_see_others {
   127→            return false;
   128→        }
   129→        // Check if layer is in no_incoming_updates (sync facts)
   130→        if self
   131→            .permit
   132→            .sync_facts()
   133→            .no_incoming_updates
   134→            .contains(&layer_name.to_string())
   135→        {
   136→            return false;
   137→        }
   138→        self.permit
   139→            .can_read_layer(layer_name, page_id, &self.subscriber_did)
   140→    }
   141→
   142→    /// Check if subscriber can write to layer
   143→    ///
   144→    /// **Context**: Used during incoming update validation
   145→    /// **Note**: Write auth stays subscriber-centric for now. For dynamic layer writes,
   146→    /// the node trusts sync_target (path 2 in Permissions::can_write).
   147→    pub fn can_write_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str) -> bool {
   148→        self.permit
   149→            .can_write_layer(layer_name, page_id, &self.subscriber_did)
   150→    }
   151→}

   270→impl ScribeState {
   271→    /// Get the next capture sequence number (monotonically increasing)
   272→    fn next_capture_seq(&self) -> u64 {
   273→        self.capture_seq.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    /// Check if a layer should sync based on permit configuration
   277→    ///
   278→    /// **Context**: Used to filter out local-only layers (sync: false) before broadcasting
   279→    /// **Returns**: true if layer should sync, false if local-only
   280→    pub fn should_sync_layer(&self, layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   281→        self.our_permit
   282→            .as_ref()
   283→            .map(|permit| permit.should_sync_layer(layer_name, &self.page_id, &self.our_did))
   284→            .unwrap_or(true) // No permit means sync everything
   285→    }
   286→
   287→    /// Check if we can write to a layer
   288→    pub fn can_write_layer(&self, layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   289→        self.our_permit
   290→            .as_ref()
   291→            .map(|permit| permit.can_write_layer(layer_name, &self.page_id, &self.our_did))
   292→            .unwrap_or(true) // No permit means full access
   293→    }

   295→    /// Emit a sync event to the capture channel (pre-serialized JSON line)
   296→    ///
   297→    /// **Context**: Called before sync_event_tx.send() to capture SyncEvent for observability
   298→    pub fn emit_sync_event_capture(&self, event: &SyncEvent) {
   299→        if let Some(ref tx) = self.capture_tx {
   300→            let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
   301→                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   302→                .map(|d| d.as_millis())
   303→                .unwrap_or(0);
   304→            if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
   305→                "type": "sync_event",
   306→                "ts": ts,
   307→                "seq": self.next_capture_seq(),
   308→                "page_id": &self.page_id,
   309→                "data": event,
   310→            })) {
   311→                let _ = tx.send(json);
   312→            }
   313→
   314→            match event {
   315→                SyncEvent::EnsureSync { .. } => {}
   316→            }
   317→        }
   318→    }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Dynamic Channel E2E Test.

Tests the full flow:
  1. Alice (owner) creates a custom channel → dynamic layer
  2. Node receives it via sync
  3. Node fans out sync_meta to bob & carol
  4. Bob & carol discover the channel
  5. Alice sends a message, it syncs to all

Usage:
    python e2e_tests/test_custom_channel.py --keep
    python e2e_tests/test_custom_channel.py --keep --capture-logs
"""

import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent / "scripts"))

from osvauld.scenario import AppTestScenario

APP_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "sample_apps" / "group-chat"

args = AppTestScenario.parse_args("Dynamic Channel E2E")

with AppTestScenario(
    name="dynamic_channel",
    app_path=str(APP_PATH),
    peers={
        "alice": {"role": "owner", "app": "Group Chat"},
        "bob": {"role": "viewer", "app": "Group Chat"},
        "carol": {"role": "viewer", "app": "Group Chat"},
    },
    **args,
) as s:
    alice = s.peer("alice")
    bob = s.peer("bob")
    carol = s.peer("carol")

    include_logs = "--capture-logs" in sys.argv

    # Start capture
    print("\n=== Dynamic Channel E2E ===")
    captures_dir = s.capture_start("dyn_channel", include_logs=include_logs)
    print(f"  Captures: {captures_dir}/")

    # Step 1: Alice creates a custom channel
    print("\n[1] Alice creates channel 'project-x'...")
    alice.eval('create_channel("project-x")')

    # Step 2: Wait for sync to node + fanout
    print("[2] Waiting 4s for sync to node + fanout...")
    time.sleep(4)

    # Step 3: Alice sends a message in the channel

-- Group Chat — standalone page definition
page("Group Chat", "1.0.0")

-- =============================================================================
-- Layers
-- =============================================================================

-- Dynamic per-channel messages — LoroMap keyed by message ID
layer("channels/{channel_id}/messages", "map", {
    sync = true, write = true, create = true,

    validate = function(ops, ctx)
        for _, op in ipairs(ops) do
            if op.op == "update" and op.old_value then
                local old = op.old_value
                local new = op.value
                if (new.text ~= old.text or new.deleted ~= old.deleted or new.edited ~= old.edited)
                   and ctx.from_did ~= old.sender_did then
                    return false, "Only sender can edit their own message"
                end
            end
        end
        return true, nil
    end
})

-- Assets for file sharing
layer("assets", "map", {
    sync = true, write = true, create = true
})

-- =============================================================================
-- App
-- =============================================================================

app("Group Chat", {
    client = {
        ui = "group-chat/app.slint",
        logic = "group-chat/app.lua"
    }
})

-- DMs & Private Channels — explicit dynamic layers with named collaborators
-- 1:1 DMs: sorted-DID stable id, 2 participants
-- Private channels: named, N participants, same explicit grant mechanism

local M = {}

-- Module state (set by init)
local page_id = nil
local my_did = nil
local my_name = nil
local active_dm = nil
local dm_entries = {}

-- Current DM's messages layer (LoroMap)
local messages_layer = nil

-- Current DM's bare layer path (for binding/rebinding)
local active_layer_path = nil

-- Callback to refresh messages when DM changes
local on_dm_switch = nil

-- Generate a stable DM id from two DIDs (sorted, last 8 chars each)
local function make_dm_id(did_a, did_b)
    local a, b = did_a, did_b
    if a > b then a, b = b, a end
    return "dm-" .. a:sub(-8) .. "-" .. b:sub(-8)
end

local function dm_owner_did(did_a, did_b)
    if did_a < did_b then
        return did_a
    end
    return did_b
end

-- Sanitize a name for use as layer id
local function sanitize_id(name)
    return name:lower():gsub("%s+", "-"):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
end

function M.init(pid, did, name, callback)
    page_id = pid
    my_did = did
    my_name = name
    on_dm_switch = callback

    dm_entries = {}
    M.refresh_dm_list()
end

local function normalize_layer_path(layer_name)
    if not layer_name then return nil end

    local prefix = page_id .. "/"
    if layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
    end

    return layer_name
end

local function split_first_two(path)
    local first, second = path:match("^([^/]+)/([^/]+)")
    return first, second
end

local function is_my_layer(layer_path)
    if not layer_path then return false end
    local _prefix, creator_did = split_first_two(layer_path)
    return creator_did == my_did
end

local function find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    local suffix = "/" .. dm_id .. "/messages"
    local matches = scribe:list_layers("*" .. suffix)
    if not matches or #matches == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    table.sort(matches)
    return matches[1]
end

local function grant_participants(layer_path, participants)
    if not layer_path or not participants then return end

    local full_layer_name = page_id .. "/" .. layer_path
    for _, did in ipairs(participants) do
        if did ~= my_did then
            pcall(function()
                scribe:add_layer_access(full_layer_name, did)
            end)
        end
    end
end

function M.create_dm(other_did, other_name)
    if other_did == my_did then return end

    local dm_id = make_dm_id(my_did, other_did)

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(dm_id)
        return
    end

    -- Reuse an existing participant layer if already visible, otherwise create.
    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    if not layer_path then
        -- Canonical owner creates the DM layer; other participant waits to discover it.
        local owner_did = dm_owner_did(my_did, other_did)
        if my_did ~= owner_did then
            return false
        end

        local result = scribe:create_layer("dms/{id}/messages", dm_id)
        layer_path = normalize_layer_path(result and result.layer_name)
    end

    dm_entries[dm_id] = {
        id = dm_id,
        is_group = false,
        participants = { my_did, other_did },
        participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name, [other_did] = other_name },
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    if is_my_layer(layer_path) then
        grant_participants(layer_path, { my_did, other_did })
    end

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    return true
end

function M.open_dm(other_did, other_name)
    if other_did == my_did then return false end

    local dm_id = make_dm_id(my_did, other_did)
    local existing = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(dm_id)
        return true
    end

    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    if not layer_path then
        return false
    end

    dm_entries[dm_id] = {
        id = dm_id,
        is_group = false,
        participants = { my_did, other_did },
        participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name, [other_did] = other_name },
        created_by = dm_owner_did(my_did, other_did),
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    return true
end

function M.create_private_channel(name, members)
    if not name or name == "" then return end
    if not members or #members == 0 then return end

    local id = sanitize_id(name)
    if id == "" then return end

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = dm_entries[id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(id)
        return
    end

    -- Build participant lists (always include self)
    local participants = { my_did }
    local participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name }
    for _, member in ipairs(members) do
        if member.did ~= my_did then
            table.insert(participants, member.did)
            participant_names[member.did] = member.name
        end
    end

    -- Reuse an existing participant layer if already visible, otherwise create.
    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(id)
    if not layer_path then
        local result = scribe:create_layer("dms/{id}/messages", id)
        layer_path = normalize_layer_path(result and result.layer_name)
    end

    dm_entries[id] = {
        id = id,
        name = name,
        is_group = true,
        participants = participants,
        participant_names = participant_names,
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    if is_my_layer(layer_path) then
        grant_participants(layer_path, participants)
    end

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(id)
end

function M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    local meta = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if not meta then return end

    active_dm = dm_id

    local layer_path = meta.layer_path
    if not layer_path then return end

    active_layer_path = layer_path
    messages_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. layer_path)

    -- Determine display name
    local display_name = meta.name
    if not display_name or display_name == "" then
        -- 1:1 DM: show other person's name
        if meta.participant_names then
            for did, name in pairs(meta.participant_names) do
                if did ~= my_did then
                    display_name = name
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not display_name then display_name = dm_id end
    end

    ui:set("active_dm", dm_id)
    ui:set("active_dm_name", display_name)

    M.refresh_dm_list()

    if on_dm_switch then
        on_dm_switch(dm_id, layer_path)
    end
end

function M.refresh_dm_list()
    local dm_list = {}
    for key, meta in pairs(dm_entries) do
        if meta and meta.participants then
            -- Only show DMs where I'm a participant
            local am_participant = false
            for _, did in ipairs(meta.participants) do
                if did == my_did then
                    am_participant = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if am_participant then
                -- Determine display name
                local display_name = meta.name
                if not display_name or display_name == "" then
                    -- 1:1 DM: show other person's name
                    if meta.participant_names then
                        for did, name in pairs(meta.participant_names) do
                            if did ~= my_did then
                                display_name = name
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not display_name then display_name = meta.id or key end
                end

                table.insert(dm_list, {
                    id = meta.id or key,
                    name = display_name,
                    is_active = (meta.id or key) == active_dm,
                    is_group = meta.is_group or false,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    -- Sort: most recent first
    table.sort(dm_list, function(a, b)
        return a.name < b.name
    end)

    ui:set("dms", dm_list)
end

--- Called when a new layer is discovered via protocol sync.
--- Parses DM layer paths and registers them.
function M.on_layer_discovered(layer_name)
    -- Strip page_id/ prefix if present
    local bare_path = layer_name
    local prefix = page_id .. "/"
    if layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
        bare_path = layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
    end

    -- Match: dms/<did>/<id>/messages
    local _did, dm_id = bare_path:match("^dms/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/messages$")
    if not dm_id then return false end

    -- If already known, just update the layer_path
    if dm_entries[dm_id] and dm_entries[dm_id].layer_path then
        return false
    end

    -- Register as discovered DM (we don't know participant names yet)
    if not dm_entries[dm_id] then
        dm_entries[dm_id] = {
            id = dm_id,
            is_group = false,
            participants = { my_did },
            participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name },
            created_at = os.time(),
            layer_path = bare_path,
        }
    else
        dm_entries[dm_id].layer_path = bare_path
    end

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    return true
end

function M.get_active_dm()
    return active_dm
end

function M.get_active_layer_path()
    return active_layer_path
end

function M.get_messages_layer()
    return messages_layer
end

return M

"""
Scenario - Multi-peer orchestration for integration testing

A Scenario manages multiple sessions (owner, node, viewer) and handles:
- Spawning all required instances
- Setting up P2P connections between them
- Cleanup on exit

Usage:
    with Scenario(owner=1, node=1, viewer=2) as s:
        # s.owner - the owner session
        # s.node - the node session (kunki)
        # s.viewers - list of viewer sessions
        s.owner.eval("add_product('Widget', 10)")
        s.wait_sync()
        assert s.viewers[0].eval("return #get_products()") == 1
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional

from .session import Session
from .client import ControlClient
from .tmux import TmuxManager
from .wait import wait_for_condition, wait_for_eval, TimeoutError


# Default paths
DEFAULT_KUNKI_BINARY = (
    Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "target" / "debug" / "kunki"
)
DEFAULT_BASE_DIR = Path("/tmp/osvauld_test")


def _capture_ts_key(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
    """Convert capture timestamp to a sortable float seconds value."""
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)

    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            return float(value)
        except ValueError:
            pass

        iso_value = value
        if iso_value.endswith("Z"):
            iso_value = iso_value[:-1] + "+00:00"
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(iso_value).timestamp()
        except ValueError:
            return None

    return None


def _merge_capture_files(capture_paths: Dict[str, Path], output_path: Path) -> Path:
    """Merge per-instance capture JSONL files sorted by timestamp."""
    merged_entries = []
    seq = 0

    for instance, file_path in capture_paths.items():
        if not file_path.exists():
            continue

        with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                raw = line.strip()
                if not raw:
                    continue

                ts_key = None
                out_line = raw
                try:
                    event = json.loads(raw)
                    if isinstance(event, dict):
                        event.setdefault("instance", instance)
                        ts_key = _capture_ts_key(event.get("ts"))
                        out_line = json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=True)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass

                merged_entries.append((ts_key is None, ts_key or 0.0, seq, out_line))
                seq += 1

    merged_entries.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], entry[1], entry[2]))
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with output_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for _, _, _, line in merged_entries:
            f.write(line + "\n")

    return output_path


class NodeSession:
    """Manages a kunki node instance."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        data_dir: str,
        socket_path: Optional[str] = None,
        kunki_binary: Optional[Path] = None,
        startup_timeout: float = 10.0,
    ):
        self.name = name
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.socket_path = socket_path or f"{data_dir}/{name}.sock"
        self.kunki_binary = kunki_binary or DEFAULT_KUNKI_BINARY
        self.startup_timeout = startup_timeout

        self.process: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
        self._client: Optional[ControlClient] = None
        self.connection_string: Optional[str] = None

    @property
    def client(self) -> ControlClient:
        """Get the ControlClient for this node."""
        if self._client is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Node '{self.name}' not started")
        return self._client

    def init(self, username: str, passphrase: str) -> None:
        """Initialize the node with a user identity."""
        if not self.kunki_binary.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Kunki binary not found: {self.kunki_binary}\n"
                "Run: cargo build -p kunki"
            )

        # Ensure data directory exists
        os.makedirs(self.data_dir, exist_ok=True)

        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                str(self.kunki_binary),
                "--db-path",
                f"{self.data_dir}/{self.name}",
                "init",
                "--username",

   186→            os.remove(self.socket_path)
   187→
   188→        env = os.environ.copy()
   189→
   190→        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
   191→            [
   192→                str(self.kunki_binary),
   193→                "--db-path",
   194→                f"{self.data_dir}/{self.name}",
   195→                "start",
   196→                "--passphrase",
   197→                passphrase,
   198→                "--debug-socket",
   199→                self.socket_path,
   200→            ],
   201→            env=env,
   202→            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
   203→            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
   204→        )

    def start(self, passphrase: str) -> "NodeSession":
        """Start the kunki process."""
        if not self.kunki_binary.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Kunki binary not found: {self.kunki_binary}")

            ],
            env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )

        # Wait for socket to be available
        start_time = time.time()
        while time.time() - start_time < self.startup_timeout:
            if os.path.exists(self.socket_path):
                try:
                    client = ControlClient(self.socket_path)
                    if client.ping():
                        self._client = client
                        # Get connection string
                        self.connection_string = client.get_connection_string()
                        return self

                    pass

        if self.process:

                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait()

   314→    def start(self) -> "Scenario":
   315→        """Start all configured sessions.
   316→
   317→        Returns:
   318→            self (for chaining)
   319→        """
   320→        if self._started:
   321→            return self
   322→
   323→        # Clean up if fresh
   324→        if self.fresh and self.base_dir.exists():
   325→            shutil.rmtree(self.base_dir)
   326→
   327→        self.base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   328→
   329→        try:
   330→            # Start nodes first (they need to be running for others to connect)
   331→            for i in range(self.node_count):
   332→                name = f"node_{i}" if self.node_count > 1 else "node"
   333→                data_dir = str(self.base_dir / name)
   334→
   335→                node = NodeSession(name, data_dir)
   336→                node.init(f"node_user_{i}", self.passphrase)
   337→                node.start(self.passphrase)
   338→                self.nodes.append(node)
   339→
   340→            # Start owners
   341→            for i in range(self.owner_count):
   342→                name = f"owner_{i}" if self.owner_count > 1 else "owner"
   343→                data_dir = str(self.base_dir / name)
   344→
   345→                session = Session(name, data_dir, show_ui=self.show_ui)
   346→                session.start()
   347→                self.owners.append(session)
   348→
   349→            # Start viewers
   350→            for i in range(self.viewer_count):
   351→                name = f"viewer_{i}" if self.viewer_count > 1 else "viewer"
   352→                data_dir = str(self.base_dir / name)
   353→
   354→                session = Session(name, data_dir, show_ui=self.show_ui)
   355→                session.start()
   356→                self.viewers.append(session)
   357→
   358→            self._started = True
   359→            return self
   360→
   361→        except Exception:
   362→            self.stop()
   363→            raise
   364→
   365→    def stop(self) -> None:
   366→        """Stop all sessions."""
   367→        for session in self.viewers:
   368→            try:
   369→                session.stop()
   370→            except Exception:
   371→                pass
   372→
   373→        for session in self.owners:
   374→            try:
   375→                session.stop()
   376→            except Exception:
   377→                pass
   378→
   379→        for node in self.nodes:
   380→            try:
   381→                node.stop()
   382→            except Exception:
   383→                pass
   384→
   385→        self.owners = []
   386→        self.nodes = []
   387→        self.viewers = []
   388→        self._started = False

   507→    def capture_start(self, label: str, include_logs: bool = False) -> Path:
   508→        """Start capture on all instances (nodes + owners + viewers)."""
   509→        if not self._started:
   510→            raise RuntimeError("Scenario not started")
   511→        if self._capture_label is not None:
   512→            raise RuntimeError(
   513→                f"Capture already active with label '{self._capture_label}'"
   514→            )
   515→
   516→        captures_dir = self.base_dir / "captures"
   517→        captures_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   518→
   519→        capture_paths: Dict[str, Path] = {}
   520→        capture_clients: Dict[str, ControlClient] = {}
   521→
   522→        for node in self.nodes:
   523→            capture_clients[node.name] = node.client
   524→
   525→        for owner in self.owners:
   526→            capture_clients[owner.name] = owner.client
   527→
   528→        for viewer in self.viewers:
   529→            capture_clients[viewer.name] = viewer.client
   530→
   531→        for instance, client in capture_clients.items():
   532→            capture_path = captures_dir / f"{label}_{instance}.jsonl"
   533→            client.capture_start(str(capture_path), include_logs=include_logs)
   534→            capture_paths[instance] = capture_path
   535→
   536→        self._capture_label = label
   537→        self._capture_paths = capture_paths
   538→        self._capture_clients = capture_clients
   539→        return captures_dir
   540→
   541→    def capture_end(
   542→        self, label: Optional[str] = None, merge: bool = True
   543→    ) -> Optional[Path]:
   544→        """Stop capture on all instances and optionally merge JSONL files."""
   545→        if self._capture_label is None:
   546→            raise RuntimeError("No active capture")
   547→        if label is not None and label != self._capture_label:
   548→            raise RuntimeError(
   549→                f"Capture label mismatch: active '{self._capture_label}', requested '{label}'"
   550→            )
   551→
   552→        active_label = self._capture_label
   553→        errors = []
   554→
   555→        for instance, client in self._capture_clients.items():
   556→            try:
   557→                client.capture_end()
   558→            except Exception as e:
   559→                errors.append(f"{instance}: {e}")
   560→
   561→        capture_paths = self._capture_paths
   562→        self._capture_label = None
   563→        self._capture_paths = {}
   564→        self._capture_clients = {}
   565→
   566→        if errors:
   567→            raise RuntimeError("Capture end failed: " + "; ".join(errors))
   568→
   569→        if not merge:
   570→            return None
   571→
   572→        merged_path = self.base_dir / "captures" / f"{active_label}_merged.jsonl"
   573→        return _merge_capture_files(capture_paths, merged_path)

   601→class PeerHandle:
   602→    """Thin wrapper over ControlClient for a peer in an AppTestScenario.
   603→
   604→    Provides eval() and wait_for() for app-level testing.
   605→    """
   606→
   607→    def __init__(
   608→        self,
   609→        name: str,
   610→        client: ControlClient,
   611→        role: str,
   612→        space_id: str,
   613→        page_id: str,
   614→        app_name: str,
   615→    ):
   616→        self.name = name
   617→        self.client = client
   618→        self.role = role
   619→        self.space_id = space_id
   620→        self.page_id = page_id
   621→        self.app_name = app_name
   622→
   623→    def eval(self, code: str) -> Any:
   624→        """Execute Lua code and return the result."""
   625→        return self.client.eval(code)
   626→
   627→    def wait_for(
   628→        self,
   629→        condition_fn: Callable[[], Any],
   630→        timeout: float = 15.0,
   631→        interval: float = 0.5,
   632→        desc: str = "condition",
   633→    ) -> Any:
   634→        """Poll until condition_fn returns a truthy value.
   635→
   636→        Args:
   637→            condition_fn: Callable returning truthy when done
   638→            timeout: Max seconds to wait
   639→            interval: Polling interval in seconds
   640→            desc: Description for timeout error
   641→
   642→        Returns:
   643→            The truthy value from condition_fn
   644→
   645→        Raises:
   646→            TimeoutError: If condition not met within timeout
   647→        """
   648→        start = time.time()
   649→        while time.time() - start < timeout:
   650→            try:
   651→                result = condition_fn()
   652→                if result:
   653→                    return result
   654→            except Exception:
   655→                pass
   656→            time.sleep(interval)
   657→        raise TimeoutError(
   658→            f"Timeout waiting for {desc} on '{self.name}' (after {timeout}s)"
   659→        )

   662→class AppTestScenario:
   663→    """One-call E2E test setup.
   664→
   665→    Automates all boilerplate: TmuxManager, signup/login, create_space,
   666→    connect/publish, add_viewer, open_app, wait for readiness.
   667→
   668→    Usage:
   669→        args = AppTestScenario.parse_args("My test")
   670→        with AppTestScenario(
   671→            name="my_test",
   672→            app_path="sample_apps/my-shop",
   673→            peers={
   674→                "owner":    {"role": "owner",  "app": "Shop Owner"},
   675→                "customer": {"role": "viewer", "app": "Shop Customer"},
   676→            },
   677→            **args,
   678→        ) as s:
   679→            owner = s.peer("owner")
   680→            customer = s.peer("customer")
   681→            owner.eval('add_product_via_ui("Widget", 99, "Test", 50)')
   682→            customer.wait_for(
   683→                lambda: customer.eval("return get_products_count()") >= 1,
   684→                desc="product sync",
   685→            )
   686→    """
   687→
   688→    def __init__(
   689→        self,
   690→        name: str,
   691→        app_path: str,
   692→        peers: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]],
   693→        base_dir: Optional[str] = None,
   694→        release: bool = False,
   695→        profiling: bool = False,
   696→        flame_only: bool = False,
   697→        heaptrack: bool = False,
   698→        keep: bool = False,
   699→        debug: bool = False,
   700→    ):
   701→        """
   702→        Args:
   703→            name: Session name (tmux session + base dir name)
   704→            app_path: Path to the app directory (e.g., sample_apps/my-shop)
   705→            peers: Dict mapping peer name to {"role": "owner"|"viewer", "app": "App Name"}
   706→                   First peer with role "owner" creates the space.
   707→            base_dir: Override base dir (default: /tmp/{name})
   708→            release: Use release builds
   709→            profiling: Enable tokio-console + flame profiling
   710→            flame_only: Enable flame graphs only (no tokio-console overhead)
   711→            heaptrack: Wrap binaries with heaptrack for heap profiling
   712→            keep: Keep session alive after test (block until Ctrl+C)
   713→            debug: Keep session on failure for debugging
   714→        """
   715→        self.name = name
   716→        self.app_path = str(Path(app_path).resolve())
   717→        self.peers_config = peers
   718→        self.base_dir = Path(base_dir) if base_dir else Path(f"/tmp/{name}")
   719→        self.release = release
   720→        self.profiling = profiling
   721→        self.flame_only = flame_only
   722→        self.heaptrack = heaptrack
   723→        self.keep = keep
   724→        self.debug = debug
   725→
   726→        self._tm: Optional[TmuxManager] = None
   727→        self._handles: Dict[str, PeerHandle] = {}
   728→        self._space_id: Optional[str] = None
   729→        self._page_id: Optional[str] = None
   730→        self._capture_label: Optional[str] = None
   731→        self._capture_paths: Dict[str, Path] = {}
   732→
   733→    def peer(self, name: str) -> PeerHandle:
   734→        """Get a PeerHandle by name."""
   735→        if name not in self._handles:
   736→            raise KeyError(
   737→                f"Peer '{name}' not found. Available: {list(self._handles.keys())}"
   738→            )
   739→        return self._handles[name]
   740→
   741→    @property
   742→    def owner(self) -> PeerHandle:
   743→        """Get the first owner peer."""
   744→        for handle in self._handles.values():
   745→            if handle.role == "owner":
   746→                return handle
   747→        raise RuntimeError("No owner peer configured")
   748→
   749→    @property
   750→    def space_id(self) -> str:
   751→        if self._space_id is None:
   752→            raise RuntimeError("Space not created yet")
   753→        return self._space_id
   754→
   755→    @property
   756→    def page_id(self) -> str:
   757→        if self._page_id is None:
   758→            raise RuntimeError("Page not created yet")
   759→        return self._page_id
   760→
   761→    @staticmethod
   762→    def parse_args(description: str) -> dict:
   763→        """Parse standard CLI args (--keep, --debug, --release).
   764→
   765→        Returns:
   766→            Dict suitable for passing as **kwargs to AppTestScenario().
   767→        """
   768→        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=description)
   769→        AppTestScenario.add_args(parser)
   770→        args = parser.parse_args()
   771→        return {
   772→            "keep": args.keep,
   773→            "debug": args.debug,
   774→            "release": args.release,
   775→        }
   776→
   777→    @staticmethod
   778→    def add_args(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
   779→        """Add standard flags to an argparse parser."""
   780→        parser.add_argument(
   781→            "--keep", action="store_true", help="Keep tmux session alive after test"
   782→        )
   783→        parser.add_argument(
   784→            "--debug", action="store_true", help="Keep session on failure for debugging"
   785→        )
   786→        parser.add_argument("--release", action="store_true", help="Use release builds")
   787→
   788→    def __enter__(self) -> "AppTestScenario":
   789→        self._setup()
   790→        return self

   792→    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
   793→        if exc_type is not None:
   794→            # Test failed
   795→            print(f"\n[FAIL] {exc_val}")
   796→            traceback.print_exception(exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb)
   797→
   798→            if self.debug:
   799→                self._print_debug_info()
   800→                self._block_until_ctrl_c()
   801→
   802→        if self.keep:
   803→            self._print_session_info()
   804→            self._block_until_ctrl_c()
   805→
   806→        if self._capture_label is not None:
   807→            try:
   808→                self.capture_end(merge=False)
   809→            except Exception:
   810→                pass
   811→
   812→        if self._tm:
   813→            self._tm.stop()
   814→
   815→        return exc_type is not None  # Suppress exception if we handled it

   817→    def _setup(self) -> None:
   818→        """Run full boilerplate setup (optimized for debug builds).
   819→
   820→        Optimizations:
   821→        - Conditional waits instead of fixed time.sleep()
   822→        - Parallel viewer connection + space sync
   823→        - Parallel app opening
   824→        - Tighter polling (0.1s vs 0.5s)
   825→        """
   826→        # Determine owner and viewer peers
   827→        owner_name = None
   828→        owner_app = None
   829→        viewer_peers = []
   830→
   831→        for pname, pconfig in self.peers_config.items():
   832→            if pconfig["role"] == "owner" and owner_name is None:
   833→                owner_name = pname
   834→                owner_app = pconfig["app"]
   835→            else:
   836→                viewer_peers.append((pname, pconfig))
   837→
   838→        if owner_name is None:
   839→            raise RuntimeError("At least one peer must have role 'owner'")
   840→
   841→        # 1. Create TmuxManager and add instances
   842→        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
   843→        print(f"  {self.name}")
   844→        print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   845→
   846→        self._tm = TmuxManager(
   847→            session_name=self.name,
   848→            base_dir=self.base_dir,
   849→            release=self.release,
   850→            profiling=self.profiling,
   851→            flame_only=self.flame_only,
   852→            heaptrack=self.heaptrack,
   853→        )
   854→        self._tm.add_node("node")
   855→        self._tm.add_shell(owner_name)
   856→        for pname, _ in viewer_peers:
   857→            self._tm.add_shell(pname)
   858→        self._tm.start()
   859→
   860→        node = self._tm.get_client("node")
   861→        owner_client = self._tm.get_client(owner_name)
   862→        print("  All instances ready")
   863→
   864→        # 2. Owner: signup, create space
   865→        print(f"\n  {owner_name}: signup, create space...")
   866→        owner_client.signup_or_login(owner_name)
   867→        space = owner_client.create_space_with_pages(self.app_path)
   868→        self._space_id = space["id"]
   869→
   870→        pages = owner_client.list_pages(self._space_id)
   871→        assert pages, "No pages after create_space_with_pages"
   872→        self._page_id = pages[0]["id"]
   873→        print(f"  Space: {self._space_id[:8]}..., Page: {self._page_id[:8]}...")
   874→
   875→        # 3. Connect to node (conditional wait, not fixed sleep)
   876→        print(f"  {owner_name}: connect to node...")
   877→        owner_client.connect_to_node(node)
   878→
   879→        print("    Waiting for node authentication...")
   880→        if not self._wait_for_node_auth(owner_client, node, timeout=10.0):
   881→            raise RuntimeError(
   882→                f"{owner_name} failed to authenticate with node within 10s"
   883→            )
   884→        print("    Node authenticated")
   885→
   886→        # 4. Publish space (conditional wait, not fixed sleep)
   887→        print(f"  {owner_name}: publish space to node...")
   888→        owner_client.publish_to_node(self._space_id)
   889→
   890→        if not self._wait_for_node_publish(node, self._space_id, timeout=10.0):
   891→            raise RuntimeError(f"Node did not receive published space within 10s")
   892→        print("  Published and synced to node")
   893→
   894→        # 5. PARALLEL: Connect all viewers and wait for space sync
   895→        print(f"\n  Connecting viewers (parallel)...")
   896→        viewer_link = owner_client.get_viewer_link(self._space_id)
   897→
   898→        viewer_page_ids = {}
   899→
   900→        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(viewer_peers)) as executor:
   901→
   902→            def connect_viewer(pname):
   903→                viewer_client = self._tm.get_client(pname)
   904→                viewer_client.signup_or_login(pname)
   905→                # Connect exactly once per viewer. add_viewer(wait_for_auth=False)
   906→                # already calls viewer.add_website(link), so calling
   907→                # add_website_with_wait afterward duplicates the connect flow and
   908→                # can race/timestamp out during auth.
   909→                viewer_client.add_website_with_wait(viewer_link, timeout=10.0)
   910→                page_id = self._wait_for_space_sync(viewer_client, pname, timeout=10.0)
   911→                if page_id is None:
   912→                    raise RuntimeError(f"{pname} failed to sync space within 10s")
   913→                return pname, page_id
   914→
   915→            future_to_peer = {
   916→                executor.submit(connect_viewer, pname): pname
   917→                for pname, _ in viewer_peers
   918→            }
   919→
   920→            for future in as_completed(future_to_peer.keys()):
   921→                pname = future_to_peer[future]
   922→                try:
   923→                    peer_name, page_id = future.result()

1→"""
     2→ControlClient - Socket communication with slint_shell control server
     3→
     4→The control server uses JSON-RPC style protocol:
     5→    Request:  {"method": "eval", "params": {"code": "return 1+1"}, "id": 1}
     6→    Response: {"result": 2, "id": 1}
     7→    Error:    {"error": {"message": "..."}, "id": 1}
     8→"""
     9→
    10→import glob
    11→import socket
    12→import json
    13→import time
    14→from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Optional
    15→
    16→
    17→class ControlClient:
    18→    """Client for communicating with slint_shell control socket."""
    19→
    20→    def __init__(self, socket_path: str, timeout: float = 30.0):
    21→        """
    22→        Args:
    23→            socket_path: Path to Unix socket (e.g., /tmp/test/owner.sock)
    24→            timeout: Command timeout in seconds
    25→        """
    26→        self.socket_path = socket_path
    27→        self.timeout = timeout
    28→        self._id_counter = 0
    29→
    30→    @classmethod
    31→    def discover(cls, instance_name: str = None, timeout: float = 30.0) -> "ControlClient":
    32→        """Auto-discover a running instance by name.
    33→
    34→        Args:
    35→            instance_name: Instance name (e.g., "owner", "viewer", "node")
    36→                          If None, discovers any available socket
    37→            timeout: Command timeout in seconds
    38→
    39→        Returns:
    40→            ControlClient connected to the discovered socket
    41→
    42→        Raises:
    43→            ConnectionError: If no matching socket found
    44→        """
    45→        pattern = f"/tmp/osvauld-debug-{instance_name or '*'}.sock"
    46→        sockets = glob.glob(pattern)
    47→        if not sockets:
    48→            raise ConnectionError(f"No socket found matching {pattern}")
    49→        return cls(sockets[0], timeout=timeout)
    50→
    51→    def _next_id(self) -> int:
    52→        self._id_counter += 1
    53→        return self._id_counter
    54→
    55→    def wait_until(
    56→        self,
    57→        condition: Callable[[], bool],
    58→        timeout: float = 10.0,
    59→        poll: float = 0.1,
    60→        desc: str = None
    61→    ) -> bool:
    62→        """Wait for a condition to become true.
    63→
    64→        Args:
    65→            condition: Callable that returns True when condition is met
    66→            timeout: Maximum time to wait in seconds
    67→            poll: Polling interval in seconds
    68→            desc: Optional description for timeout error
    69→
    70→        Returns:
    71→            True when condition is met
    72→
    73→        Raises:
    74→            TimeoutError: If condition not met within timeout
    75→        """
    76→        start = time.time()
    77→        while time.time() - start < timeout:
    78→            try:
    79→                if condition():
    80→                    return True
    81→            except Exception:
    82→                pass
    83→            time.sleep(poll)
    84→        raise TimeoutError(desc or "Condition not met within timeout")
    85→
    86→    def wait_for_sync(
    87→        self,
    88→        other: "ControlClient",
    89→        check_code: str,
    90→        timeout: float = 10.0
    91→    ) -> bool:
    92→        """Wait for data to sync to another instance.
    93→
    94→        Args:
    95→            other: The other ControlClient to check
    96→            check_code: Lua code that returns truthy when synced
    97→            timeout: Maximum time to wait
    98→
    99→        Returns:
   100→            True when synced
   101→
   102→        Raises:
   103→            TimeoutError: If sync not complete within timeout
   104→        """
   105→        return self.wait_until(
   106→            lambda: other.eval(check_code),
   107→            timeout=timeout,
   108→            desc=f"Sync to {other.socket_path}"
   109→        )
   110→
   111→    def send(self, method: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Any:
   112→        """Send a command and return the result.
   113→
   114→        Args:
   115→            method: Command method name (e.g., "eval", "login", "list_spaces")
   116→            params: Optional parameters dict
   117→
   118→        Returns:
   119→            The result field from the response
   120→
   121→        Raises:
   122→            ConnectionError: If socket connection fails
   123→            RuntimeError: If server returns an error
   124→        """
   125→        cmd: Dict[str, Any] = {"method": method, "id": self._next_id()}
   126→        if params:
   127→            cmd["params"] = params
   128→
   129→        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
   130→        try:
   131→            sock.connect(self.socket_path)
   132→            sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
   133→            sock.send((json.dumps(cmd) + '\n').encode())
   134→
   135→            # Read response (may be large)
   136→            chunks = []
   137→            while True:
   138→                chunk = sock.recv(65536)
   139→                if not chunk:
   140→                    break
   141→                chunks.append(chunk.decode())
   142→                # Check if we have complete JSON
   143→                try:
   144→                    response = json.loads(''.join(chunks))
   145→                    break
   146→                except json.JSONDecodeError:
   147→                    continue
   148→
   149→            response = json.loads(''.join(chunks))
   150→        except socket.error as e:
   151→            raise ConnectionError(f"Socket error: {e}")
   152→        finally:
   153→            sock.close()
   154→
   155→        # Check for error
   156→        if "error" in response:
   157→            err = response["error"]
   158→            msg = err.get("message", str(err)) if isinstance(err, dict) else str(err)
   159→            raise RuntimeError(f"{method} failed: {msg}")
   160→
   161→        return response.get("result")

   383→    def add_website_with_wait(self, connection_string: str, timeout: float = 10.0) -> Dict:

   393→        import time
   394→        import base64

   397→        # Parse connection string to get node_id

   399→        try:
   400→            decoded = json.loads(base64.b64decode(connection_string))
   401→            node_public_key = decoded.get("node_public_key", "")
   402→            # Convert base64 public key to hex node_id

   404→            node_id = key_bytes.hex()
   405→        except Exception as e:

   410→
   411→        # Wait for authentication with node (if we have node_id)
   412→        if node_id:
   413→            start = time.time()
   414→            while time.time() - start < timeout:
   415→                try:
   416→                    if self.is_node_authenticated(node_id):

   418→                except Exception:

   603→        /// Opaque payload - app defines format (JSON with type/x/y, etc.)
   604→        payload: Vec<u8>,
   605→    },
   606→
   607→    /// Send structured ephemeral with func name (permission-validated)
   608→    ///
   609→    /// **Context**: Local user wants to broadcast structured ephemeral (typing, cursor, etc.)
   610→    /// **We do**: Validate func against our permit's ephemeral_funcs, then broadcast
   611→    /// **Design**: Structured format allows permission control per-function
   612→    SendStructuredEphemeral {
   613→        /// Function name (validated against permit.ephemeral_funcs)
   614→        func: String,
   615→        /// Arguments (arbitrary JSON)
   616→        args: serde_json::Value,
   617→    },
   618→
   619→    /// Remote structured ephemeral received (needs validation)
   620→    ///
   621→    /// **Context**: Peer sent structured ephemeral via datagram
   622→    /// **We do**: Validate func against sender's permit, then emit to app subscribers
   623→    RemoteStructuredEphemeral {
   624→        /// Sender's DID
   625→        from_did: String,
   626→        /// Sender's device ID
   627→        device_id: String,
   628→        /// Function name (validated against sender's permit)
   629→        func: String,
   630→        /// Arguments
   631→        args: serde_json::Value,
   632→    },
   633→
   634→    // Derivation Operations (via ScribeLuaRuntime)
   635→    /// Rebuild a derived layer from all source layers
   636→    ///
   637→    /// **Context**: Called on startup or manual rebuild request
   638→    /// **We do**: Clear derived layer, transform ALL entries from ALL matching sources
   639→    RebuildDerived {
   640→        target: String,
   641→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<std::result::Result<usize, String>>,
   642→    },
   643→
   644→    /// Rebuild all derived layers (on startup)
   645→    RebuildAllDerived {
   646→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<std::result::Result<(), String>>,
   647→    },
   648→
   649→    /// Check if derivation is enabled on this Scribe
   650→    ///
   651→    /// **Context**: Lua bindings check before registering rules
   652→    IsDerivationEnabled {
   653→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<bool>,
   654→    },
   655→
   656→    /// Create an empty derived layer
   657→    ///
   658→    /// **Context**: When registering a derivation rule, create target layer
   659→    CreateDerivedLayer { target_layer: String },
   660→
   661→    // App Refresh Operations
   662→    /// Refresh app from filesystem (owner only)
   663→    ///
   664→    /// **Context**: Owner wants to reload app code from disk (development workflow)
   665→    /// **We do**: Read files from app_dir, update app layer, commit (triggers broadcast)
   666→    /// **Consumers**: UI Reload button, Debug socket command
   667→    RefreshApp {
   668→        app_name: String,
   669→        app_dir: PathBuf,
   670→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<std::result::Result<Vec<String>, String>>,
   671→    },
   672→
   673→    /// Get app files from in-memory layer
   674→    ///
   675→    /// **Context**: App restart needs current files from Scribe's in-memory layer
   676→    /// **We do**: Extract files from app layer and return
   677→    /// **Why**: Storage may be stale; Scribe has the latest synced content
   678→    GetAppFiles {
   679→        app_name: String,
   680→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<std::result::Result<HashMap<String, String>, String>>,
   681→    },
   682→
   683→    /// Get subscriber count (for Lua peers:count() binding)
   684→    ///
   685→    /// **Context**: Node script wants to check if anyone is listening before broadcasting
   686→    /// **We do**: Return count of current subscribers
   687→    GetSubscriberCount {
   688→        reply: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<usize>,
   689→    },
   690→}
   691→

1→//! Storage traits for Scribe actor
     2→//!
     3→//! Butler implements these using RedbStore + encryption.
     4→//! Scribe only knows about the abstract interface.
     5→//!
     6→//! ## Design
     7→//!
     8→//! These traits replace the closure-based storage injection pattern:
     9→//! - `LayerStorage` replaces `SaveLayerFn`
    10→//! - `PeerVectorStorage` replaces `LoadPeerVectorFn` + `SavePeerVectorFn`
    11→//! - `PeerResolver` replaces `ListAuthorizedUsersFn` + `LoadUserPermitFn`
    12→//!
    13→//! Each trait is scoped to a single page (page_id passed at construction time).
    14→
    15→use std::collections::HashMap;
    16→use std::sync::Arc;
    17→
    18→use crate::Result;
    19→
    20→// Layer Storage Trait
    21→
    22→/// Layer persistence (scoped to a page)
    23→///
    24→/// **Implemented by**: Butler's RedbStore + encryption layer
    25→/// **Used by**: Scribe flush handler, immediate app layer saves
    26→pub trait LayerStorage: Send + Sync {
    27→    /// Save layer snapshot
    28→    ///
    29→    /// **Context**: Called during periodic flush or immediate save (app layers)
    30→    /// **Implementor**: Should encrypt data before persistence
    31→    fn save_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()>;
    32→}
    33→
    34→// Peer Vector Storage Trait
    35→
    36→/// Peer state vector persistence (scoped to a page)
    37→///
    38→/// **Implemented by**: Butler's RedbStore
    39→/// **Used by**: Scribe subscription handling, unsubscription, flush
    40→///
    41→/// State vectors track what each peer has already received.
    42→/// This enables incremental sync (send only what they're missing).
    43→pub trait PeerVectorStorage: Send + Sync {
    44→    /// Load peer's state vectors for all layers
    45→    ///
    46→    /// **Context**: Called when peer subscribes to restore their last known state
    47→    /// **Returns**: HashMap of layer_name -> state_vector bytes, or None if first connection
    48→    fn load_vectors(
    49→        &self,
    50→        user_did: &str,
    51→        device_id: &str,
    52→    ) -> Result<Option<HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;
    53→
    54→    /// Save peer's state vectors for all layers
    55→    ///
    56→    /// **Context**: Called during flush and on unsubscribe
    57→    /// **Note**: Vectors are stored as-is (Loro's binary format)
    58→    fn save_vectors(
    59→        &self,
    60→        user_did: &str,
    61→        device_id: &str,
    62→        vectors: &HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    63→    ) -> Result<()>;
    64→}
    65→
    66→// Peer Resolver Trait (Node Mode Only)
    67→
    68→/// Peer authorization (node mode only)
    69→///
    70→/// **Implemented by**: Butler's permit store
    71→/// **Used by**: Scribe for node-mode peer lookup and validation
    72→///
    73→/// Only used when Scribe runs on a node (is_node=true).
    74→/// Allows looking up authorized users and their permits.
    75→pub trait PeerResolver: Send + Sync {
    76→    /// List all authorized user_dids for this page
    77→    ///
    78→    /// **Context**: Node mode sync - finding peers to broadcast to
    79→    /// **Returns**: List of DIDs that have permits for this page
    80→    fn list_authorized_users(&self) -> Vec<String>;
    81→
    82→    /// Load a user's permit for this page
    83→    ///
    84→    /// **Context**: Node mode - getting permit for validation/role extraction
    85→    /// **Returns**: Permit token string if user has access, None otherwise
    86→    fn load_user_permit(&self, user_did: &str) -> Option<String>;
    87→}
    88→
    89→// Permit Issuer Trait (Node Mode Only)
    90→
    91→/// Layer permit issuance (node mode only, scoped to a page)
    92→///
    93→/// **Implemented by**: Butler using signing key + gurkha
    94→/// **Used by**: Scribe layer_unit for issuing layer permits on dynamic layer detection
    95→///
    96→/// Scribe must never hold signing keys. This trait abstracts permit creation
    97→/// so Scribe can request permits without accessing crypto directly.
    98→pub trait PermitIssuer: Send + Sync {
    99→    /// Issue a layer permit for a single dynamic layer

-- Group Chat App — Slack-like with channels, threads, reactions
-- Entry point: on_init, on_click routing, typing

local channels = require("channels")
local dms = require("dms")
local messages = require("messages")
local threads = require("threads")
local helpers = require("ui_helpers")
local read_tracker = require("read_tracker")

-- State
local page_id = nil
local my_did = nil
local my_name = nil
local view_mode = "channels"  -- "channels" or "dms"

-- Typing indicator state
local typing_users = {}
local last_typing_sent = 0

-- Member picker state (Lua-side, not UI property)
local selected_member_dids = {}  -- { [did] = name }

-- Emoji shortcodes (for reaction via context menu)
local EMOJI_SHORTCODES = {
    Smile = "grinning_face", Laugh = "joy", Heart = "heart", Thumbs = "thumbsup",
    Fire = "fire", Party = "tada", Rocket = "rocket", Star = "star",
    Check = "white_check_mark", Wave = "wave", Eyes = "eyes", Think = "thinking",
    Clap = "clap", ["100"] = "100", Sad = "cry", Angry = "angry",
    Cool = "sunglasses", Wink = "wink", LOL = "rofl", Love = "heart_eyes",
    Sparkles = "sparkles", Pray = "pray", Muscle = "muscle", Tada = "confetti_ball",
    Crown = "crown", Gem = "gem_stone", Lightning = "zap", Trophy = "trophy",
    Brain = "brain", Ghost = "ghost",
}

function on_init()
    page_id = scribe:page_id()
    my_did = scribe:my_did()
    my_name = USERNAME or scribe:my_name() or my_did:sub(-8)

    -- Init modules
    messages.init(my_did, my_name)
    threads.init(my_did, my_name)
    read_tracker.init(page_id, my_did, my_name)

    -- Set profile footer state
    ui:set("my_display_name", my_name)

    -- Init channels — callback fires on every channel switch (including initial "general")
    local messages_bound = false
    channels.init(page_id, my_did, my_name, function(channel_id, layer_path)
        -- First call: create binding. Subsequent calls: rebind to new layer.
        if not messages_bound then
            scribe:bind("messages", layer_path, {
                key = "id",
                transform = function(msg)
                    if not msg then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if msg.thread_parent_id and msg.thread_parent_id ~= "" then
                        return nil  -- filter thread replies from main view
                    end
                    return messages.to_ui_message(msg)
                end
            })
            messages_bound = true
        else
            scribe:rebind("messages", layer_path)
        end

        -- Refresh thread if open (may be in same channel)
        if threads.is_open() then
            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
        end

        -- Mark as read and update sidebar badges
        read_tracker.mark_read(channel_id, channels.get_messages_layer())
        channels.refresh_channel_list()
    end, read_tracker)

    -- Init DMs — callback rebinds "messages" to the DM layer
    dms.init(page_id, my_did, my_name, function(dm_id, layer_path)
        view_mode = "dms"
        ui:set("view_mode", "dms")

        -- Rebind main messages to DM layer (initial bind was done by channels.init)
        if messages_bound then
            scribe:rebind("messages", layer_path)
        end
    end)

    -- Init UI state
    ui:set("view_mode", "channels")
    ui:set("auto_scroll", true)
    ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
    ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
    ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
    ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
    ui:set("thread_open", false)
    ui:set("thread_draft", "")

    -- Initial read tracking (binding handles UI sync)
    refresh_messages()
end

-- Get the active messages layer based on current view mode
local function get_active_messages_layer()
    if view_mode == "dms" then
        return dms.get_messages_layer()
    else
        return channels.get_messages_layer()
    end
end

-- Build member picker model from known peers
-- TODO: use a peer directory instead of presence layer
local function refresh_member_picker()
    ui:set("member_picker", {})
end

-- Refresh messages side effects (read tracking + badges)
-- The binding system handles UI sync; this only does read-tracking
function refresh_messages()
    if view_mode == "dms" then return end
    local layer = channels.get_messages_layer()
    read_tracker.mark_read(channels.get_active_channel(), layer)
    channels.refresh_channel_list()
end

function on_click(target)
    -- Sidebar collapse toggles
    if target == "toggle_channels" then
        ui:set("channels_collapsed", not ui:get("channels_collapsed"))
        return
    end
    if target == "toggle_online" then
        ui:set("online_collapsed", not ui:get("online_collapsed"))
        return
    end

    -- Channel switching
    if target:match("^switch_channel:") then
        local id = target:sub(16)
        view_mode = "channels"
        ui:set("view_mode", "channels")
        channels.switch_channel(id)
        threads.close()
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
        return
    end

    -- DM switching
    if target:match("^switch_dm:") then
        local id = target:sub(11)
        dms.switch_dm(id)
        threads.close()
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
        return
    end

    -- Start 1:1 DM from online users list
    if target:match("^start_dm:") then
        local rest = target:sub(10)
        local did, name = rest:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
        if did and name then
            dms.create_dm(did, name)
        end
        return
    end

    -- DM sidebar collapse toggle
    if target == "toggle_dms" then
        ui:set("dms_collapsed", not ui:get("dms_collapsed"))
        return
    end

    -- Create private channel modal
    if target == "create_private_channel" then
        ui:set("new_private_channel_name", "")
        selected_member_dids = {}
        refresh_member_picker()
        ui:set("show_create_private_channel", true)
        return
    end

    if target == "cancel_create_private_channel" then
        ui:set("show_create_private_channel", false)
        selected_member_dids = {}
        return
    end

    if target == "confirm_create_private_channel" then
        local name = ui:get("new_private_channel_name") or ""
        -- Build members list from selection
        local members = {}
        for did, mname in pairs(selected_member_dids) do
            table.insert(members, { did = did, name = mname })
        end
        if name ~= "" and #members > 0 then
            dms.create_private_channel(name, members)
        end
        ui:set("show_create_private_channel", false)
        selected_member_dids = {}
        return
    end

    if target:match("^toggle_member:") then
        local rest = target:sub(15)
        -- Parse "DID:NAME" where DID can contain colons (did:key:...)
        -- Find the last colon to separate DID from name
        local last_colon = rest:match(".*():")
        if last_colon then
            local did = rest:sub(1, last_colon - 1)
            local mname = rest:sub(last_colon + 1)
            if did and mname then
                if selected_member_dids[did] then
                    selected_member_dids[did] = nil
                else
                    selected_member_dids[did] = mname
                end
                refresh_member_picker()
            end
        end
        return
    end

    -- Thread operations
    if target:match("^open_thread:") then
        local msg_id = target:sub(13)
        threads.open(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        return
    end

    if target == "close_thread" then
        threads.close()
        return
    end

    if target == "thread_submit" then
        threads.send_reply(channels.get_messages_layer())
        refresh_messages()
        return
    end

    -- Reactions
    if target:match("^toggle_reaction:") then
        local parts = {}
        for part in target:gmatch("[^:]+") do table.insert(parts, part) end
        if #parts >= 3 then
            messages.toggle_reaction(channels.get_messages_layer(), parts[2], parts[3])
            refresh_messages()
            if threads.is_open() then
                threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
            end
        end
        return
    end

    if target:match("^add_reaction:") then
        local msg_id = target:sub(14)
        ui:set("selected_message_id", msg_id)
        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", true)
        return
    end

    -- Context menu
    if target:match("^toggle_menu:") then
        local msg_id = target:sub(13)
        local current = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
        if current == msg_id then
            ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        else
            ui:set("selected_message_id", msg_id)
        end
        return
    end

    if target == "context_menu:reply" then
        local msg_id = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
        local raw = messages.get_raw(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
        if raw then
            ui:set("replying_to_id", msg_id)
            ui:set("replying_to_text", helpers.truncate_text(raw.text, 40))
        end
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        return
    end

    if target == "context_menu:thread" then
        local msg_id = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
        threads.open(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        return
    end

    -- Edit message
    if target:match("^edit_message:") then
        local msg_id = target:sub(14)
        local raw = messages.get_raw(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
        if raw and raw.sender_did == my_did then
            -- Put text in draft for editing (simple approach)
            ui:set("draft_text", raw.text)
            ui:set("replying_to_id", "edit:" .. msg_id)
            ui:set("replying_to_text", "Editing message...")
        end
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        return
    end

    -- Delete message
    if target:match("^delete_message:") then
        local msg_id = target:sub(16)
        messages.delete(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
        refresh_messages()
        if threads.is_open() then
            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
        end
        return
    end

    -- Emoji picker
    if target == "emoji_picker:toggle" then
        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", not ui:get("show_emoji_picker"))
        return
    end

    if target == "emoji_picker:close" then
        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
        return
    end

    if target:match("^emoji:") then
        local emoji_name = target:sub(7)
        local selected = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
        if selected ~= "" then
            -- Add reaction to selected message
            local emoji_char = messages.resolve_emoji(emoji_name)
            messages.toggle_reaction(channels.get_messages_layer(), selected, emoji_char)
            ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
            ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
            refresh_messages()
            if threads.is_open() then
                threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
            end
        else
            -- Insert into draft text
            messages.insert_emoji_to_draft(emoji_name)
            ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
        end
        return
    end

    -- Reply cancel
    if target == "cancel_reply" then
        ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
        ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
        return
    end

    -- Autoscroll
    if target == "toggle_autoscroll" then
        ui:set("auto_scroll", not ui:get("auto_scroll"))
        return
    end

    -- Attach file
    if target == "attach_file" then
        pick_asset_file("images")
        return
    end

    -- Create channel modal
    if target == "create_channel" then
        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
        ui:set("show_create_channel", true)
        return
    end

    if target == "cancel_create_channel" then
        ui:set("show_create_channel", false)
        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
        return
    end

    if target == "confirm_create_channel" then
        local name = ui:get("new_channel_name") or ""
        if name ~= "" then
            channels.create_channel(name)
        end
        ui:set("show_create_channel", false)
        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
        return
    end
end

function on_submit()
    local text = ui:get("draft_text")
    if not text or text == "" then return end

    local layer = get_active_messages_layer()
    if not layer then return end

    local replying_to = ui:get("replying_to_id") or ""

    -- Check if editing
    if replying_to:match("^edit:") then
        local msg_id = replying_to:sub(6)
        messages.edit(layer, msg_id, text)
        ui:set("draft_text", "")
        ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
        ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
        refresh_messages()
        return
    end

    -- Normal send
    local reply_preview = ui:get("replying_to_text") or ""
    messages.send(layer, text, replying_to, reply_preview)

    ui:set("draft_text", "")
    ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
    ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
    ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
    ui:set("selected_message_id", "")

    refresh_messages()
end

function on_text_input(text)
    local now = os.time()
    if now - last_typing_sent >= 2 then
        scribe:send("typing", { user = my_name, channel = channels.get_active_channel() })
        last_typing_sent = now
    end
end

function on_ephemeral(user_did, func, args)
    if func == "typing" and user_did ~= my_did then
        -- Only show typing for current channel
        if args and args.channel == channels.get_active_channel() then
            local user = args.user or user_did:sub(-8)
            typing_users[user_did] = { timestamp = os.time(), name = user }
            refresh_typing_indicator()
        end
    end
end

function refresh_typing_indicator()
    local now = os.time()
    local active = {}
    local stale = {}

    for did, info in pairs(typing_users) do
        if now - info.timestamp < 3 then
            table.insert(active, info.name)
        else
            table.insert(stale, did)
        end
    end

    for _, did in ipairs(stale) do
        typing_users[did] = nil
    end

    if #active == 0 then
        ui:set("typing_text", "")
    elseif #active == 1 then
        ui:set("typing_text", active[1] .. " is typing...")
    else
        ui:set("typing_text", #active .. " people typing...")
    end
end

-- Asset upload callback
function on_asset_uploaded(asset)
    if asset and asset.hash then
        messages.send_with_attachment(
            channels.get_messages_layer(),
            "[File: " .. (asset.filename or "file") .. "]",
            asset.hash,
            asset.filename or "file"
        )
        refresh_messages()
    end
end

-- New layer discovered via protocol sync (dynamic layers arriving from peers)
function on_layer_discovered(layer_name)
    -- Try channels first, then DMs
    if channels.on_layer_discovered(layer_name) then return end
    if dms.on_layer_discovered(layer_name) then return end
end

-- Layer change callback for non-bound layers.
-- Bound layers (messages) are handled by the binding system automatically.
function on_loro_change(layer_name)
    -- Active DM messages changed
    if view_mode == "dms" then
        local dm_path = dms.get_active_layer_path()
        if dm_path and layer_name:sub(-#dm_path) == dm_path then
            return
        end
    end

    -- Active channel messages changed (handles read tracking + thread refresh)
    local active_path = channels.get_active_layer_path()
    if active_path and layer_name:sub(-#active_path) == active_path then
        refresh_messages()
        if threads.is_open() then
            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
        end
    end
end

-- Periodic typing cleanup
timer.setInterval(1000, function()
    refresh_typing_indicator()
end)

-- API exports
api.export("send_message", function(text)
    messages.send(channels.get_messages_layer(), text)
    refresh_messages()
end)
api.export("create_channel", function(name) channels.create_channel(name) end)
api.export("switch_channel", function(id) channels.switch_channel(id) end)
api.export("get_active_channel", function() return channels.get_active_channel() end)
api.export("get_message_count", function()
    local layer = channels.get_messages_layer()
    if not layer then return 0 end

end)

api.export("create_dm", function(did, name) dms.create_dm(did, name) end)
api.export("open_dm", function(did, name) return dms.open_dm(did, name) end)
api.export("create_private_channel", function(name, members)

api.export("send_dm_message", function(text)
    local layer = dms.get_messages_layer()
    if layer then

end)
api.export("get_dm_message_count", function()
    local layer = dms.get_messages_layer()
    if not layer then return 0 end
    return layer:length()
end)
api.export("get_active_dm", function() return dms.get_active_dm() end)
